article.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and Granary v2: Intelligent Multilingual Transcription You Can Prompt and Adapt

harvestedTerms.summary: NVIDIA announces Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open-weight multimodal speech model handling transcription, speaker diarization, translation, and audio Q&A across dozens of languages. The article also covers the Granary v2 data pipeline for fine-tuning and benchmarks across multiple ASR leaderboards. Core technical concepts include speaker diarization, a hybrid Mamba–Transformer MoE architecture, and prompt-guided transcription control.

article.title: AI Is Thriving at Capital One | Thomas H. Davenport and Randy Bean

harvestedTerms.summary: A practitioner-focused case study on Capital One's AI deployment, covering agentic AI for call summarization, open-weight models in risk/compliance, AI-assisted software development, and the bank's philosophy of long-term value over short-term ROI. The article draws on interviews with Capital One's chief AI officer and chief data officer.

article.title: Meta Earnings, Muse and the Frontier, Musebook

harvestedTerms.summary: A paywalled Stratechery article about Meta's Q3 2026 earnings, covering Meta's AI agent 'Muse,' its investment thesis around frontier compute, and a product called 'Musebook.' The excerpt is largely a subscription gate with minimal technical content exposed. Only the framing around Muse and Meta's compute spending is visible.

Simon Willison's brief note on the GitHub Octoverse 2026 report highlights dramatic growth metrics — tripled pull requests, tripled commits, doubled repository creation — attributed to agentic engineering's impact on developer workflows. The post also notes methodological details: LLM-based classification for geographic attribution and a fine-tuned multilingual embedding model for industry sector classification of repositories.

article.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon with a ‘significant leap’ in cybersecurity

harvestedTerms.summary: Google has released Gemini 4 Carbon, a new frontier model positioned primarily around cybersecurity capabilities, with benchmark leadership on SEC-bench Pro and ExploitGym. The article covers the model's availability through Google's Fairwind Program, pricing, and capability comparisons with Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra.
